name: Checkers
tagline: Play the computer, or send a link and a friend takes the other colour.
description:
The computer thinks on this device. Pass the phone, or press Play a friend and send the invite: the same board, live, on two devices. Close it mid-game and the board keeps.

A ten-by-ten board. White and black take turns. Men step one square forward on the diagonal. You must jump when you can, and a jump can chain. Reach the far side and the man becomes a king, who may go any way. Take all of the other side, or leave them with nowhere to go, and you win. White goes first. Tap a piece, then tap where it goes.

An unofficial port of Checkers by stroibot. The computer is the same one that shipped with that game.
